title: C4OS Grill Question 025 - Prompt Tag Routing

questions.label: What should `@` tags target in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: plugin resources and files, with available targets determined by enabled plugins. This matches the original task list and keeps files under the FS/IDE plugin path.
options: Plugin resources and files, based on enabled plugins

questions.label: What should `/` commands route to in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: agent CLI/runtime commands exposed through the runtime/tool gateway, not arbitrary frontend parsing.
options: Agent CLI/runtime commands through the runtime/tool gateway
Both C4OS commands and runtime commands

questions.label: What should `$` tags target in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: skills only, because this preserves the Codex-style skill invocation boundary.

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify disabled plugin behavior, missing FS/IDE behavior, tag search UI, or how tags become runtime context.
